notes: WebSearch could not be used for this part (the session's search budget was already spent), so pages were reached directly: the campaign websites filed with the Secretary of State, government, party and newspaper sites, and those sites' own search pages. Candidates with nothing below are ones for whom no such page stated anything a card may show.

Sites that asked scripts to stay out or refused them, and so were not read: rockholdforhouse.com and columbiaheightsmn.gov (robots.txt), tkforheights.com (403), mncourts.gov (403: no court page for the judge), mn.gov (a CAPTCHA page), co.roseau.mn.us (a CAPTCHA page on its commissioners page), ramseycountymn.granicus.com and sd67dfl.org (robots.txt), austindailyherald.com and albertleatribune.com (403), and the search pages of pinejournal.com and inforum.com (robots.txt).

Read and left out on purpose: ages given as "age on Election Day" (KAXE's guides), which do not fix a birth year; jobs, including assistant county attorney and sheriff's office posts; schools; labor and other non-party endorsements; and a 2024 candidacy Wikipedia lists as "did not file" on the strength of a social media post.

party_support (a key the loader does not read, in the shape parts 6 and 10 use): two listings where a party unit publishes its backing under a heading that is not plainly an endorsement. The Senate District 37 DFL names Justin Navratil under "DFL Supported Candidates", apart from its endorsed candidates; the Clay County Republicans name Andrew Rockhold on a page titled "Endorsed & Supported Candidates" that does not say which word applies to whom. They are kept apart from endorsed_by so that no page calls them endorsements; whether and how they are shown is John's decision.

From the researcher, still standing: David Gottfried is a sitting member whose roster record has no birth date, so the Legislative Reference Library's date is given; Mai Chong Xiong's start year is the county page's "was elected in 2023"; Tamara Mattison's county post takes its years from her own site, and the county's own record that she sat on that commission is its minutes of January 10, 2024, at https://assets.ramseycountymn.gov/files/migrated-files/01.10.24_Parks_Commission_Minutes.pdf.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: every address below was opened again with the kit's own User-Agent (robots.txt asked first) and each finding read on the page. Every campaign address was also found in the Secretary of State files John saved. rockholdforhouse.com still asks scripts to stay out, so that site was not read; its address is confirmed by the Clay County Republicans' page, which links it under "MN House HD4A, Andrew Rockhold". Judge Leeser's appointment now rests on InForum's report, which spells his name as our list does (the WJON page printed "Michael Lesser"). The Rogers voter's guide prints Rick Ihli's name as "Rick Ilhi"; the December 2024 article spells it as our list does and states the same three posts. What was removed and why is under "removed".
